messages:
devrel_bot: Kicking off the post-all-hands thread for strategy Qs — drop quick clarifying questions here.
jamie_ceo: Thanks — keeping answers short here, follow-ups welcome.
morgan_vp_prod: Pricing question: how aggressively do we discount Dedicated commits vs hosted usage to encourage migrations?
jamie_ceo: We want clear step-up economics. Offer modest committed discounts (15-30%) plus migration credits for 1st year. Not a fire sale — we need margin for SRE + SLAs.
maya_sales: Customers ask about predictable latency guarantees. Do we commit to p99 targets or a more application-specific SLA?
olivia_cto: We should baseline p95 p99 by model class and instance type. SLA should be per-route with configurable SLOs; default guarantees for enterprise tiers.
kiran_research: On the "serving-first" message: should we publish an independent benchmark kit for transparency vs competitors?
jamie_ceo: Yes — _transparent_ perf profiles are core to our positioning. Put a reproducible kit in OSS or a public repo and link it from docs.
riley_marketing: Need a short elevator pitch: two-liner that non-technical execs can understand — can someone draft?
jamie_ceo: Draft: "Redwood makes building with LLMs predictable and affordable — ship fast on hosted, scale reliably on dedicated or private with enterprise SLAs." Riley, iterate with Olivia.
morgan_vp_prod: Competitor angle: some incumbents highlight proprietary models + exclusive features — do we call that out directly in sales?
maya_sales: Callouts should be factual: "We match or exceed in latency/price for common workloads" and explain migration paths. Avoid name-calling.
kiran_research: Compliance customers keep asking about reproducibility & audits for open models. We should publish our model verification checklist.
jamie_ceo: Agreed. Kiran, own a short checklist: model provenance, quantization artifacts, perf regression test, and privacy assessment.
olivia_cto: Tech differentiator to highlight: unified runtime + automatic KV caching + smart routing. These drive predictable unit costs — not just raw model quality.
riley_marketing: On messaging, I'll prepare 3 one-liners for Hosted / Dedicated / Private and a short FAQ.
jamie_ceo: Great. Owners: Morgan for product positioning, Riley for messaging, Kiran for audits, Olivia for tech spec. I'll review drafts by EOD Friday.
maya_sales: Can we get a single slide for customer-facing decks summarizing the migration path and economics?
jamie_ceo: Yes — Morgan + Maya, draft slide and share in this thread.
devrel_bot: Resource: internal draft folder /*link removed*/ (will post public kit after leadership review).
jamie_ceo: Thanks all. If you have heated debates, take to 1:1s — we want crisp public messaging.
